facts.fact: Liberia, The Gambia and Sierra Leone signed a memorandum of understanding on roaming, led by Liberia's telecom authority with Sierra Leone's National Communications Authority and The Gambia's regulator; the document gives no signing date, so the published date 2025-02-05 is used.

systems.owner: Liberia Telecommunication Authority, National Communications Authority (Sierra Leone), Public Utilities Regulatory Authority (The Gambia)

note: Start of the Sierra Leone-Liberia phase is stated as a future date (2 May 2025), so no effect fact.
